reason: SWE-Master is a reproducible post-training framework (trajectory synthesis, long-horizon SFT, RL with execution feedback) that raises Qwen2.5-Coder-32B to 61.4% on SWE-bench Verified; despite mentioning inference framework design, the contribution is agent post-training, not inference systems.
title: SWE-Master: Unleashing the Potential of Software Engineering Agents via Post-Training
